convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to call a custom indicator 'TEMA_CUSTOM' and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) cannot be replicated with built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: downtrend detected (Value[1]<Value[2]) triggers BUY_Close when BuyPosClose=true; uptrend detected (Value[1]>Value[2]) triggers SELL_Close when SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size of MM=0.1; other MarginMode options (FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) use MM as a fraction of margin/balance for lot calculation via TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions: (1) trend direction determined by Value[1] vs Value[2] (previous two bars), AND (2) momentum confirmation via Value[0] vs Value[1] (current signal bar vs previous). For long: Value[1]<Value[2] (downtrend in prior bars) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (indicator turning up). For short: Value[1]>Value[2] (uptrend in prior bars) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (indicator turning down). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as feature toggles. Signal is only recalculated on new bar or when Recount flag is set (after CopyBuffer failure). SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the most recently closed bar, not the forming bar. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: The TEMA_CUSTOM indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it uses custom smoothing algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard EMA). The Triple EMA logic with three independently configurable smoothing methods is non-trivial. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose which handle margin-based lot calculation, position checking, and order placement - these must be reimplemented. The new-bar guard (CIsNewBar class) is essential for signal timing. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points - need digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10 if _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). The entry logic uses a 3-bar comparison pattern: bar[2] vs bar[1] for trend, bar[1] vs bar[0] for momentum confirmation.
